title: Building Systems Cutaway
description: Students will identify (Bloom Level 1, Remember) the six building systems in a simple building section and analyze (Bloom Level 4, Analyze) which other systems are affected when one system changes.
creator: The Science of the Built Environment
author: Dan McCreary
subject: The Science of the Built Environment
chapter_title: Introduction to the Built Environment and Construction Terminology

pedagogical.learningObjective: Identify the six building systems in a house section and analyze which other systems are affected when one system changes.
recommendedUsage: Click a system name in the legend to hide or show that system's layer. Each swatch is labeled with text as well as color.
Click any component, or hover for its name, to see its system and the other systems that depend on it. Those systems stay bright and the rest fade.
Choose a What if? scenario (Remove insulation, Add a large window, or Move the furnace) to see which system changes and which others are affected.
Press Reset view to bring back all layers and clear the selection.
activities: Warm-up (5 min): Students hide all layers but one and list the components of that system from memory before revealing it.
Explore (10 min): Students click five components in different systems and record which systems depend on each one.
Analyze (10 min): Students run each What if? scenario, predict the affected systems first, then compare with the sim and discuss any they missed.
assessment: Students name the six systems and give one component of each.
Students explain in three sentences how removing wall insulation affects at least two other systems.
